fomod.Name: VRTouchEvents V3.4
fomod.Author: VRTouchEvents
fomod.Description:
VR physical contact bridged to SkyrimNet - touching, grabbing, kissing, pushing, dressing and choking an NPC become LLM-driven reactions in her own voice, decided by where you touched, how, how long, and what she is wearing.
Touch is sensed by Precision Physic Bodies (PPB), which puts real collision capsules on the body and reports exactly where you touched, with what (finger, palm, fist, grab, weapon, held object), how deep and for how long. Includes KISSING (including a kiss that travels from the lips to the neck), PUSH / SHOVE / STUMBLE / LEG SWEEP reactions, and EQUIP / UNEQUIP AWARENESS - put gear on an NPC by hand or pull it off and she knows, ordinary armour and Devious Devices alike. Interrupts cut only the NPC who is actually talking, so you never cut someone else off mid-sentence.
REQUIRES: SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer (the prompts ship as a SkyrimNet content layer, which older SkyrimNet does not read); Precision Physic Bodies (PPB); HIGGS and VRIK (PPB's detection runs off a HIGGS frame callback and fails silently without it, even if you never grab anything); PLANCK (required - VRTouchEvents is built on top of it). VRTouchEvents.esp must be ticked in your load order.
The installer lets you choose how talkative ordinary contact is (every held touch can earn a spoken reply, or the quieter "subtle" feel), whether pushes are narrated, and whether gear changes are narrated - the last one matters if you use Gift by Hand VR, which can absorb gear you hold out to an NPC before the equip finishes.
Optional: Arousal + Facial Reactions (opt-in, costs LLM tokens); SexLab and OStim scene-suppression patches (strongly recommended if you use either); and "No Follower Grab".
Pairs with the DD SN Database / "SkyrimNet Devious Awareness Base" for device-specific awareness. Database 1.3.1 or newer is needed for VRTouchEvents to name a locked device correctly when a pull is refused.
